basic_info.description: Experience luxury living at its finest with the Bush Residences, where sophistication meets breathtaking views. This unit comes fully furnished with an impeccable renovation that boasts stunning north-facing vistas of the Bay, the iconic Coit Tower, and the city skyline. Designed for modern elegance, every detail has been thoughtfully curated to enhance comfort and style. Nestled in the heart of San Francisco's Financial District, this exclusive unit residence offers unparalleled convenience with easy access to all parts of San Francisco. The attention to detail is unparalleled, from the marble bathrooms with Dorn Bracht water fixtures to the generous dining/living room with built-in projector. To top it off this unit has been extensively remodeled with a design and taste worthy of a humble boast. The chef inspired epicurean kitchen has been remodeled with Arclinea cabinetry & Miele appliances to elevate your day to day experience. The serene escape above the city is only a tour away. Don't miss your opportunity to own a piece of the skyline schedule your private tour today!
